premises.text: Interactive touch screens are becoming prevalent in classrooms
premises.evidence_span: more than a quarter of United States classrooms have one of these in them

premises.text: Different manufacturers create incompatible software for interactive content
premises.evidence_span: there are a lot of different companies manufacturing these, and every single one of them has a different piece of software for building interactive content

premises.text: Browser-based software allows access to content from any device and enables simultaneous interaction
premises.evidence_span: this is now completely browser-based. It works on any device that has a browser. The other, it means that multiple people can interact with this content simultaneously

premises.text: Math can be effectively taught using interactive tools that auto-format equations
premises.evidence_span: it's really hard to do math on a computer no longer

premises.text: Published lessons can be accessed and interacted with by many users simultaneously
premises.evidence_span: a million people can look at this simultaneously, interact with it

premises.text: Offline versions of lessons can be created for classroom use
premises.evidence_span: you can even download an offline version of this that doesn't require you be connected to the internet

value.text: Education can be transformed through accessible and interactive digital content

notes: Funding and registration details excluded as traction.
